variants.headline: Still in view: money in hand, no food to buy
variants.sub: People have money for food but cannot buy it because shops and farms are sold out.
variants.body:
Shops and farms are sold out of food, leaving people with money unable to buy meals. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

A pay packet is meant to support a life. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Still in view: shops and farms sell out
variants.sub: Food is unavailable to buyers even with money in hand: shops and farms are sold out.
variants.body:
